name: Dead Man's Drive
detailed_description:
Overview

Buckle up and prepare for a hellish ride through the afterlife! Dead Man’s Drive is an adrenaline-fueled vehicular combat game where you must traverse nightmarish landscapes, blasting your way through waves of demonic entities in a battle for survival. Armed to the teeth and fueled by vengeance, your only hope is to drive, shoot, and destroy anything that stands in your path.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced Vehicular Combat: Engage in high-octane battles with a variety of supernatural foes, from swarming ghouls to towering monstrosities.

  • Weaponized Vehicles: Customize and upgrade your ride with devastating weapons, reinforced armor, and powerful mods to stay ahead of the horrors chasing you.

  • Hellish Landscapes: Journey through twisted realms, from burning wastelands to eerie ghost towns, each filled with deadly obstacles and relentless enemies.

  • Survival & Strategy: Manage your vehicle’s health, ammo, and fuel while making split-second decisions to stay alive in an unforgiving world.

  • Dynamic Weather & Terrain: Face environmental hazards such as lava pits, crumbling roads, and supernatural storms that will test your driving and combat skills.

  • Brutal Boss Fights: Take on massive, grotesque bosses that will push your reflexes and firepower to the limit.

Do You Have What It Takes to Escape?

Your soul is trapped in a place where only the strongest survive. The road ahead is long and filled with horrors—but with the right firepower and driving skills, you just might carve your way to freedom.

short_description: Blast through hellish landscapes in Dead Man’s Drive, a high-speed vehicular combat game where survival is the only goal. Arm your ride with deadly weapons, face relentless supernatural foes, and conquer brutal environments. Drive, shoot, and escape—if you can.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 21H2 or later)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super (6 GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio (e.g., Realtek ALC887 or equivalent)
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times with UE5’s virtual texturing and Nanite. Ray tracing and Lumen fully supported with compatible GPUs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Octa-core Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (3.8 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti (8 GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (12 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio with 5.1/7.1 surround support (e.g., Realtek ALC1220 or Creative Sound Blaster AE-5)
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times with UE5’s virtual texturing and Nanite. Ray tracing and Lumen fully supported with compatible GPUs.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes shooting entities with guns.
